title: Delete dead core/navigation re-export shims and break the app_router↔guards import cycle
rule: coding-standards.md:63 "dependency direction is strictly app → features → core"; adjacent to Rule 2's "do not add other barrel/re-export files"
why: The W1.2 refactor (commit eb9e7fb7, message: "Old core/navigation/ paths become re-export stubs so all 42 importers keep compiling without mass edits") moved the real router files to lib/app/router/ but the promised cleanup never happened. Three of this batch's own guards (pin_guard.dart:3, profile_guard.dart:6, restore_guard.dart:8) still import the OLD core/navigation/app_router.dart shim to reach route classes, and lib/app/router/app_router.dart imports those same three guards (line 8 and neighbours) — producing a real import cycle app→core→(shim)→app that spans exactly the boundary coding-standards.md:63 calls "strict". Dart tolerates the cycle at compile time, but it makes the documented layering diagram false and blocks ever extracting core/ as a standalone package. Two of the four shims are worse than merely redundant: app_shell.dart has zero importers anywhere in the repo (fully dead), and guards/auth_guard.dart is imported only by 3 test files (test/core/navigation/app_shell_test.dart, auth_guard_test.dart, story_acceptance/epic_01_foundation_test.dart) — production code already migrated off it, tests didn't.
recommendation: Point pin_guard.dart/profile_guard.dart/restore_guard.dart's route-class imports at lib/app/router/app_router.dart directly (or, better, pass the needed PageRouteInfo constructors in via the guard constructor so core/ guards don't need to know about app/router at all). Delete app_shell.dart outright (dead). Delete guards/auth_guard.dart and repoint its 3 remaining test importers at lib/app/router/guards/auth_guard.dart. Leave router_provider.dart's shim only if a follow-up ticket is filed to finish its migration too.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rln "core/navigation/app_shell.dart\|core/navigation/guards/auth_guard.dart" learning_tracker/lib learning_tracker/test` returns no matches (files deleted, callers repointed).
make audit gains a core→app check mirroring existing check 14/15 (core→features).
